faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our services and booking process.

booking.q: How do I book a tour?
booking.a: You can book a tour directly through our website by selecting your preferred package, or contact our specialists via phone/email for personalized assistance.

payment.q: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.a: We accept all major credit/debit cards, bank transfers, and secure online payment systems. Payment options are displayed during the booking process.

cancellation.a: Cancellation policies vary by tour. Generally, cancellations made 30 days before departure receive a partial refund. Please check your specific tour terms.

visa.q: Do you help with visa applications?
visa.a: Yes, we provide visa assistance and invitation letters for most of our destinations. Our team will guide you through the document submission process.

insurance.a: Travel insurance is not included in standard packages, but we strongly recommend it. We can help you find a suitable insurance provider.

companyInfo.subtitle: About Us
companyInfo.title: Naseem's Travel
companyInfo.description: Your trusted partner for unforgettable group travel experiences across the legendary Silk Road and beyond.
companyInfo.paragraph1: Naseem's Travel is a UK-registered travel company specializing exclusively in group tours across Central Asia. With deep expertise in Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and beyond, we craft journeys that bring travelers together to explore ancient cities, stunning landscapes, and rich cultural heritage.
companyInfo.paragraph2: Unlike traditional tour operators, we focus solely on group experiences. This allows us to offer competitive pricing, foster meaningful connections between travelers, and provide a level of local expertise that individual travel simply cannot match.

highlight.title: Group tours only
highlight.description: We specialize exclusively in group travel. This unique focus allows us to create deeply immersive experiences while offering the best value for your journey. Travel with like-minded adventurers and create memories together.
